items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: he says, 'I want to have somebody do it and I want you to come over to my office... And make an arrangement'

ctx.x: You say you went down to Youman's rehearsal and nothing ever happened --

Nothing was happened then and he said, 'I got a tune,' he says, and he says, 'I want to have somebody do it and I want you to come over to my office,' and he said, 'There's a girl over there, Marian Harris. She's going to sing in the show and I want you to hear her sing. And make an arrangement,' and fine. I went over there, it was on the 24th floor of some building I used to know, but I don't know it now, and she was in the office there lying down on the couch, she had just come in town and she was tired.
